problem: worldserver access violation while replacing a player's override-spells aura

evidence: The minidump module timestamp and image size match the privately archived original executable; the original map timestamp also matches.
The old handler calls Aura::Remove through its virtual method and then advances the erased std::list node. RBX is zero at mov r8,[rbx+10h].
The captured AuraEffect/SpellInfo identify spell 198425; RBP contains override ID 641. The remaining live override list contains the new aura.
The stack continues through HandleEffect, _HandleEffect, _ApplyAura, UpdateTargetMap, AddAura, SetAuraStack and SmartScript::ProcessAction.
